Context: 5. Reinstatement

2. Full pay and allowances admissible.(1) Reinstatement on full exoneration in departmental proceedings, when the charged official is not held responsible for delay in the termination of the proceedings against him.
- (2) Reinstatement on an official's acquittal on merits of the case in Court proceedings and no further departmental enquiry is held.
